name: Clearing showers
story: The day behind the storm: a cold, gusty northwesterly, towering showers marching down the sound with rainbows behind them, and between them the clearest air of the year. By night the sky is swept clean and the aurora is out.
forecast: Northwest 12 kt gusting 20. Cumulus and showers 11:00-17:00, base 1300 m, 5 km in showers. Visibility 90 km between. Clear, cold night: strong aurora likely.
